column1: # lane declaration — who owns which territory, at which phase, and who outranks them.
# artifact
# kind: command|hook|agent|skill · phase: understand|shape|decide|plan|build|verify|review|ship|any
# yields_to: comma-list of artifacts that outrank this one on THEIR territory, or -
# Contract and gates: scripts/lib/plugin-checks.sh (pc_lanes_*).
# report is a dispatcher over installed-versions (one territory, command yields to skill).
# The skill's yields are the consumers its README names: the inventory is INPUT to
# the plugin-scout skill's suggestion, devops's compose generation and taskmaster's
# context scan, and each of those outranks it on its own job. plugin-scout's row yields
# back to this skill as version truth — a mutual pair between two territories, not a cycle.
# package-hygiene's yields are the two hand-offs its description states: add-at-all is
# approaches' build-vs-buy, docs-before-integration is api-design's api-docs-first.
# suggest dispatches over two skills (the plugin-scout and vercel-skills-scout plugins
# merged in on 2026-09-14): plugin mode suggests marketplace plugins; --skills searches
# the open ecosystem for what the marketplace lacks. The command claims the plugin-mode
# territory and yields to both skills; the two skills are a mutual pair between two
# territories — plugin-scout routes uncovered stacks to --skills, vercel-skills-scout
# leaves marketplace plugins to plugin-scout — not a cycle.
